newsitem.title: USA: Legal Research officers buy company stock.
newsitem.headline: Legal Research officers buy company stock.

text.p: Legal Research Center Inc said on Monday that two of its officers and a director have bought a total of 1.040 million shares of the company's common stock.
Chief executive Christopher Ljungkull and president James Seidl purchased 500,000 shares each, while James Seifert, a director, purchased 40,000 shares.

The purchases are being made through a seven year non-recourse note with the shares pledged as collateral. After taking into effect the purchase price of the shares plus interest over the term of the notes, the effective cost is $3.02 per share, the company said.
